player_prompt.intro:
Tusanyuse ku Lights Out! Oli mwesigwa wa {size}x{size} wa masigi.
Lakiri lyo ni okkisa masigi ONA (egiyitibwa '.')
Bwe tukaaba masigi, ekwatagana n'ebisigiyeko (wansi/juula/ku ddala/ku dda usiri).
Andika [row col] okkaaba masigi (0-indexed, kwa mugatte, kye kigazi 0-{max_index}).
Oli mwesigwa {max_turns} emipiira okusulula puzzle.
Legend: 'O' = masigi ON, '.' = masigi OFF

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ekikolwa kirina okubeera mu kika [row col] nga olunyiriri n'olugambo biba nnamba entuufu okuva ku 0 okutuuka ku {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Mwebale nnyo! Omazzeemu ekizibu mu ntambula ya {moves_used}!
